decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the core dairy range, so keeping it costs little, and its early positive signal still supports holding the option even though it has not been visible on the website since 2018.

The mild soft cheese is the most mainstream item of the soft-cheese range and cheap to produce alongside the core business, so it stays for now, but its absence from the website after 2018 suggests its value has not clearly shown.

After four years the niche washed-rind cheese has produced no visible evidence of value, the firm has already cut most of its 2018 cheese options, and its specialised production ties up resources better used in the established business or new projects.
